verdict.rationale: Column provides building blocks for scoped programmatic access. Custom Roles offer granular controls down to specific bank accounts and transfer types, API keys are bound to sandbox or live mode, and a community comment notes per-account-number ACH permissions and limits. The API also supports balance reporting and transfer initiation, but nothing describes agent-operated accounts as a named use case. Missing for 10: vendor documentation of AI-agent account operation by name, documented per-credential amount caps on transfers, counterparty allowlists, and evidence that Custom Roles apply to API keys rather than only dashboard users.
